# TODAY

> > TODAY is NBC's morning show brand featuring live broadcasts from Rockefeller Plaza, comprehensive shopping guides, beauty product reviews, and expert lifestyle recommendations.

TODAY combines its iconic television presence with Shop TODAY, an e-commerce platform offering curated product recommendations, deal coverage (especially Amazon), and annual Beauty Awards. The site serves as both a visitor resource for attending live tapings at Studio 1A and a trusted shopping destination with expert-tested reviews.

## Key Topics

- Shop TODAY
- Amazon deals and products
- Beauty Awards
- Product recommendations
- Rockefeller Center Plaza visits
- Studio 1A
- Skincare and beauty products
- Shopping deals
- Gift guides
- Product reviews
- TODAY Show live tapings
- Expert-tested products
- Amazon fashion
- Home organization
- Seasonal sales coverage
